Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Under Regulation 29 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 For Rescheduling Of Right Issue Committee Meeting
OUTCOME OF RIGHTS ISSUE COMMITTEE MEETING OF PRATIK PANELS LIMITED HELD ON 15TH JULY, 2026

analysis.summary: Pratik Panels Limited's annual report for the financial year 2024-25 outlines financial results, board changes, and strategic proposals including corporate rebranding and object clause alteration. During the year, the company incurred a profit after tax of Rs. 25.59 lakhs and was primarily engaged in trading activities. Management has proposed changing the company's name to Treegate Agritrade Limited and expanding operations into agricultural products. Additionally, the company increased its authorized share capital and adjusted foreign investment limits to support future business plans.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the profit was inadequate for paying remuneration to executive directors due to reduced revenue, marginal expense increases, and lower profit margins.
margins_costs.quote: Due to reduction in revenue, marginal increase in expenses and less profit margin, the profit is inadequate for payment of remuneration to executive directors of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: Directors did not recommend any dividend for the year 2024-25 due to accumulated losses.
capital_allocation.quote: In view of the accumulated losses of the Company, your directors do not recommend any dividend for the year 2024-25 and no amount has been transferred to Reserve during the year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: In view of the accumulated losses of the Company, the directors did not recommend any dividend for the year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: In view of the accumulated losses of the Company, your directors do not recommend any dividend for the year 2023-24 and no amount has been transferred to Reserve during the year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The company neither accepted nor renewed any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013 during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, your Company has neither accepted nor renewed any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not recommend any dividend for the year 2022-23 in view of accumulated losses.
capital_allocation.quote: In view of the accumulated losses of the Company, your directors do not recommend any dividend for the year 2022-23 and no amount has been transferred to Reserve during the year 2022-23.

capital_allocation.claim: The funds raised through preferential issuance of equity shares were entirely utilized according to the object of the issue.
capital_allocation.quote: The funds raised were entirely utilized to as per the object of the issue.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Regional Provident Fund Commissioner II passed two orders determining damages and interest amounting to Rs.12,05,253 and Rs.6,09,912 respectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: We draw attention to Note 2.35 (a) to the financial statement that during the year Regional Provident Fund Commissioner II has passed two orders determining Damages and Interest amounting to Rs.12,05,253/- and Rs.6,09,912/- respectively relevant to the period from 01.11.2006 to 30.11.2022.

management_commitments.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to proceed with the Scheme of Arrangement and approved its withdrawal.
management_commitments.quote: However, The Board has on 11th June, 2024, decided not to proceed with the Scheme and approved withdrawal of the Scheme.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
